findings.title: Reinforcement Learning Pair Trading: A Dynamic Scaling approach
findings.notes: RL-based dynamic position scaling for pairs. H246/H271 already exhausted ETF pairs. Stock-level pairs (H200) is the next candidate. RL scaling could layer on top of H200 if it ever confirms.

findings.title: From Hypotheses to Factors: Constrained LLM Agents in Cryptocurrency Markets
findings.notes: OOS Sharpe 1.55, 44.55% annualized (2024-2026). Constrained DSL approach prevents overfitting. Adapts to equity factor search. STAGED as H288.

findings.title: Janus-Q: End-to-End Event-Driven Trading via Hierarchical-Gated Reward Modeling
findings.notes: 62,400 annotated news articles with event types + CAR labels. +102% Sharpe improvement, +17.5% direction accuracy. Event-type annotation is new signal layer for H174 PEAD pipeline. STAGED as H287.

findings.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
findings.notes: Combines FinBERT sentiment + 15 fundamentals + 3 technicals. Transformer outperforms LSTM on F1. Confirms multi-modal approach but no concrete Sharpe numbers. Lower priority — H287 covers event-type improvement more concretely.

findings.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
findings.notes: 138k+ press releases 2005-2023. FinBERT yields highest predictive power. Press release structure matters — specific sections more predictive. Already partially covered in nlp-alternative-data.md. No new staging needed.

findings.title: Cross-sectional factor momentum: evidence from multiple formation periods
findings.notes: 2025 study confirms multi-period formation for factor momentum is significant. Recent + intermediate horizons both matter. Consistent with H255 design but H255 was NOT CONFIRMED (Corr=0.89 SPY). The multi-period extension would need long-short construction to isolate factor alpha.

findings.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: Bias Correction
findings.notes: A-share focused. Bias correction mask first pattern. H275 already staged for this.

findings.title: Generating Alpha: Hybrid AI Trading System with Regime-Adaptive Equity Strategies
findings.notes: 135.49% return over 24 months. Combines EMA/MACD + RSI/BB + FinBERT + XGBoost + regime filter. No Sharpe reported; 24-month test is too short. Methodology confirms H286 Var B direction (regime-adaptive equity). No staging — covered by existing confirmed H series.

findings.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets (evidence map)
findings.notes: Systematic audit of 77 studies. Critical reproducibility crisis: 0/19 achieve R3 reproducibility. Only 2 have time-consistent split protocols. Validates Kevin's 7-point checklist. STAGED as wiki update to multi-agent-llm-trading.md.

findings.title: StockBench: Can LLM Agents Trade Stocks Profitably In Real-world Markets?
findings.notes: Most SoTA LLMs fail to beat buy-and-hold in real sequential trading. Strong financial QA != effective trading. Thinking models better for arithmetic. Bundled with arXiv:2605.19337 wiki update (staged in proposal 4).

findings.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: Multi-Agent LLM with Fine-Grained Tasks
findings.notes: Already in wiki (multi-agent-llm-trading.md). No new staging.

findings.title: Language Model Guided Reinforcement Learning in Quantitative Trading
findings.notes: LLM generates high-level strategies to guide RL agents. Increased cumulative returns 7.9% → 19.22%. H276 (NautilusTrader POC) is the relevant execution layer. Could combine with H288 LLM factor search if H288 confirms.

findings.title: New News is Bad News (news entropy predicts negative returns)
findings.notes: News novelty entropy (RNN over large corpus) predicts negative returns. Better OOS predictor than standard measures. Cross-sectional negative risk premium unexplained by existing factors. STAGED as H289.

findings.title: gs-quant (Goldman Sachs) — 10k stars
findings.notes: Goldman institutional-grade Python toolkit. Primarily for derivatives pricing and risk analytics. Too heavyweight for current project scope. Note for future reference if options/derivatives work expands.

findings.title: hftbacktest — 3.9k stars
findings.notes: Rust-based HFT backtesting. Not relevant until market microstructure work begins. Note for H-series beyond H300 if intraday execution ever becomes a priority.

findings.title: FinRL-Trading (AI4Finance-Foundation)
findings.notes: FinRL-X next-gen modular RL trading infrastructure. Relevant to H204 (Deep RL PPO). H204 was NOT CONFIRMED but FinRL-X is more modular than original FinRL. Note for future H-series RL experiments.
